title: Reward Breakage Before Expiry
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), no-spend days (`nospend:day`), price-per-use items (`priceperuse:item`), cash-back rewards (`cashback:reward`).
app: Bank-transaction exports categorised for micro-spending, no-spend-day trackers, price-per-use logs, and cash-back / rewards feeds — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cashback:reward
| eval days_to_expiry=round((expiry_date-now())/86400,0)
| stats sum(balance) as balance, min(days_to_expiry) as soonest_expiry by program
| where soonest_expiry<=30
| sort soonest_expiry
description: Flags rewards balances that are likely to expire unused.
value: Cash-back and points feel like gains, but unused rewards are just deferred waste.
implementation: Ingest reward-balance snapshots with expiry dates; alert when expiry is near and value is still unclaimed.
visualization: Table of reward programs with balance and days to expiry.
grandmaExplanation: It logs which rewards or points are about to expire unused, so free money does not vanish by neglect.
